visibilityNote: Visible launcher apps only · Permission grants do not prove use.
reportCount: {count, plural, =0{No reports} one{1 report} other{{count} reports}}
consentHeadline:
A clear account.
A safer next step.
consentIntro:
Something felt wrong? Start here.
Describe it in your words, then review before sharing.
consentWordsText: Description, language, incident type, and optional app and evidence notes.
consentChoiceText: Device checks are optional. Nothing is submitted until you review and confirm.
consentStorageText: Drafts stay on this device. Submitted reports go to the local API for administrator review.
consentNotice: Synthetic demonstration only. Do not enter real employee information. No sign-in or production access controls. Microphone audio is not saved, sent or analysed.
reviewFactsDescription: These are the exact report facts to be sent. The API adds a ticket ID, timestamps and initial status.
reviewConfirmationIncluded: Submission includes your explicit confirmation: true.
reviewConfirmFacts: I confirm these facts and want to create this ticket.
syntheticExample: Use synthetic details only. Example: an unexpected IT-support caller asked you to install a remote-access app or share a code.
pendingSubmission: A submission may already have reached the API. Retry the preserved reviewed report to retrieve its ticket safely. Editing is paused until this is resolved.
descriptionTooShort: Describe the incident in at least 10 characters.
androidDeviceReview: With your consent, check whether Android reports a secure screen lock. This does not check installed remote-access apps or permission use.
iosDeviceReview: Automatic device checks are unavailable on iOS in this stage. Review installed apps and permissions manually in Settings, or contact your known helpdesk.
checkExplanation: Read secure screen-lock configuration now and include its result and timestamp in your report. No runtime permission is needed.
reviewDeviceCheck: Review and consent to device check
helpIntro: Know what is shared, what is stored, and what this stage can check.
observationDisclaimer: These observations do not establish remote access, compromise, or whether a permission was used.
helpStorage: Use synthetic data only. Drafts are stored locally in app preferences, without encryption. Submitted facts are stored by the local API in SQLite. Administrator notes stay in the administrator view. This demonstration has no authentication.
helpSettings: Opening settings does not change any setting. On Android you can inspect this app’s settings; on iOS you can open this app’s Settings page. Review other apps and permissions manually through system Settings. A visible permission does not prove it was used.
helpRoles: Security and data protection are separate reviewer roles in the demonstration model. Real employee data requires server-enforced access control and a defined retention policy.
settingsOpenError: Could not open settings. Open system Settings manually.
admin_localApiHistory: Reports and audit history from the local API
admin_analyticsUnavailable: Analytics unavailable. Refresh the queue to retry.
admin_dragBrushHint: Drag across either weekly chart or choose weeks. Totals remain unchanged.
admin_viewClosureTime: View reports contributing to closure time
admin_assignmentIdentityNote: Team assignment is separate from employee identity.
admin_chartSubtitle1: New reports in consecutive seven-day buckets
admin_chartDefinition1: Counts reports by receipt time within the selected window. The final bucket may be shorter than seven days.
admin_chartDefinition2: Each report appears in exactly one category. Percentages use reports received in the selected window.
admin_chartSubtitle3: Activity by calendar month within this window
admin_chartDefinition3: Received counts new reports; closed counts transitions into closed, including reports received before this window. Partial months are included.
admin_chartSubtitle4: Currently closed reports received in this window
admin_chartDefinition4: The gauge shows the closed share, not an SLA target. Duration bins use receipt to latest closure; reopened reports are excluded until closed again.
admin_chartSubtitle5: Current workflow state · click a cell for its queue
admin_chartDefinition5: Counts the current statuses of reports received in this window. Status indicates workflow, not severity or a security conclusion.
admin_chartSubtitle6: Historical state at the end of each plotted bucket
admin_chartDefinition6: Includes all matching reports received by each snapshot, even before this reporting window. Closed is an administrative status; reopening moves a report back to open.
admin_decisionAudited: This decision will be persisted and audited.
